nodes.title: SG-2.1 Versioned save format with migration
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/state/persistence.ts redefines GameState with loose types (unknown[]) and writes the bare state with no version. Desired behavior: persistence imports GameState from types.ts, writes {version, state}, runs migrate for legacy unversioned JSON and throws on unknown versions, still validating every field. Expected result: old saves still load, new saves are versioned, and the player-visible game is unchanged. Why: one GameState owner and a safe save format for future changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a state, when serializeState output is parsed, then it equals {version: CURRENT_VERSION, state}
- Given legacy unversioned JSON, when deserializeState runs, then the same GameState is returned
- Given corrupt JSON or an invalid field, when deserializeState runs, then it throws
- Given a version greater than CURRENT_VERSION, when deserializeState runs, then it throws an unsupported version error


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/state/persistence.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/runtime/storage.ts
- In scope: unit tests for round trip, legacy, corrupt and future version
- Out of scope: SG-2.2 Single Zustand owner of GameState
- Out of scope: backend/ and frontend/src/api/client.ts
- Out of scope: new features, content or art
- Preserve: Per-field validation rules
- Preserve: STORAGE_KEY and localStorage fallback behaviour
- Preserve: Gameplay, transitions and animations


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API out of scope


## Definition of done
- All requirements met and their Verify units green
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Persistence imports the single GameState and writes {version, state}
nodes.body:
Context: persistence.ts declares its own GameState interface (L4-L13) and serializeState (L16-L18) returns JSON.stringify(state). Desired behavior: import GameState from ./types, export CURRENT_VERSION = 1, and serialize {version: CURRENT_VERSION, state}. Expected result: one GameState definition and every new save carries a version. Why: single owner and evolvable format.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given persistence.ts, when searched, then it declares no GameState and imports it from ./types
- Given any GameState, when serializeState runs, then JSON.parse(output) equals {version: CURRENT_VERSION, state}


## Scope
- In scope: persistence.ts type import
- In scope: CURRENT_VERSION export
- In scope: serializeState envelope
- Out of scope: deserialize and migrate logic
- Out of scope: storage.ts
- Preserve: Field validation


## Technical constraints
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- No source file over 200 lines
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- GameState defined once in src/state/types.ts
- serializeState writes the envelope


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · deserializeState migrates legacy saves, rejects future versions and corrupt input
nodes.body:
Context: deserializeState (L21-L62) parses and validates a bare state. Desired behavior: add exported migrate(raw) that returns raw.state for version CURRENT_VERSION, returns legacy unversioned objects unchanged, and throws 'Unsupported save version' for any other version; deserializeState parses, calls migrate, then runs the existing field validation. Expected result: old saves load, future or corrupt saves throw. Why: no player loses a save and no newer save is misread.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given legacy unversioned state JSON, when deserializeState runs, then it returns that state
- Given {version: CURRENT_VERSION+1, state}, when deserializeState runs, then it throws Unsupported save version
- Given corrupt JSON, an invalid versioned state, or '{}', when deserializeState runs, then it throws
- Given a serializeState output, when deserializeState runs, then the original state is returned


## Scope
- In scope: migrate
- In scope: deserializeState
- In scope: validation extracted into a local validateState
- Out of scope: storage.ts
- Out of scope: serializeState
- Preserve: Every existing field check and its error message


## Technical constraints
- No test deleted or skipped
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend


## Dependencies
- INT
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- migrate exported
- Future versions throw
- Legacy saves load


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Runtime storage loads and saves only through the versioned persistence functions
nodes.body:
Context: frontend/src/runtime/storage.ts imports GameState from @game/state/types and casts the deserializeState result (L14-L19). Desired behavior: after REQ1 and REQ2 the return type is already GameState, so remove the cast and the stale comment; readSaved still returns null for missing, corrupt or future-version saves. Expected result: saves written in the old format still load, new saves are versioned, and useGame still reaches state only via the store. Why: finishes the versioned save wiring at the real entry point.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a legacy unversioned save in localStorage, when readSaved runs, then it returns that GameState
- Given writeSaved output, when read from localStorage, then it holds the versioned envelope and readSaved returns the same state
- Given corrupt or future-version data, when readSaved runs, then it returns null without throwing


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/runtime/storage.ts
- Out of scope: Single store ownership refactor (SG-2.2)
- Out of scope: useGame.ts changes
- Preserve: STORAGE_KEY value
- Preserve: null on unavailable storage


## Technical constraints
- Every step lands green in game/ and game/frontend/
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- backend/ and api/client.ts out of scope


## Dependencies
- REQ1
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- No cast remains in storage.ts
- Old saves still load


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: migrate(raw) with version check, then existing validation
nodes.description: Refactor deserializeState in persistence.ts: JSON.parse, migrate, then validateState containing the current field checks unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy loads
Future version throws
Corrupt throws

steps.action: Add exported migrate(raw: unknown): unknown. If raw is a plain object with a 'version' key: return raw.state when version === CURRENT_VERSION, otherwise throw Error(`Unsupported save version: ${String(raw.version)}`). Otherwise return raw unchanged (legacy unversioned shape equals the current state shape).
steps.code: export function migrate(raw: unknown): unknown { if (isPlainObject(raw) && 'version' in raw) { if (raw.version === CURRENT_VERSION) return raw.state; throw new Error(`Unsupported save version: ${String(raw.version)}`); } return raw; }
steps.expected: migrate exported and handles the three cases.

steps.action: Rename the existing body after JSON.parse into function validateState(parsed: unknown): GameState keeping every check and message; make deserializeState return validateState(migrate(JSON.parse(json))).
steps.code: export function deserializeState(json: string): GameState { return validateState(migrate(JSON.parse(json))); }
steps.expected: Legacy and versioned JSON validate; '{}' still throws 'Invalid game state: currentScene'.
